The second-pass commit changes only docs and doctests.

ApplicabilityRefusal moved; it was not copied.
No dependency was added. IdentityHasher (core repository/types.rs:32-85) is small glue that feeds derived-Hash bytes to the existing DigestPort, so the store key keeps one digest algorithm.

The rewrite tests take their expected rows from running the unrewritten plan (execution tests/project_phase/rewrites/test.rs:125-240). The PlanIdentity row asserts properties (repository/service_test.rs:202-215). The premise changes in 4dad7e48b2 state their reasons and ran green in validation331. The new doctests assert behaviour rather than restating values.

The diff adds no unsafe and no #[allow], and every added unwrap, expect or panic is in test or fixture code. index_among returns Option (query_language pushing/service.rs:163-176), so a missing column refuses the rewrite instead of reading column 0.
